body:
### Problem
D-263 says a Gleam project whose JavaScript runtime is Node checks Node's version without declaring it. In `test_tools`, that automatic check is added only when no declared entry names Node. So a project that declares Node for some tests only (for example `{ tool = "node >= 19", tests = ["workspace::"] }`) loses the automatic check for every other test, and a too-old Node goes unnoticed for them.

### Done when
- In a Gleam project on Node, a declared Node entry that names tests applies to those tests, and the automatic Node check still applies to the others.
- A declared Node entry that names no tests still replaces the automatic check.
- Tests cover both cases.

The matching change to solace-cli's own `solace.toml` is task:1f49b71f50451044.
title: test tools: automatic Node check beside a scoped entry
